answer: Treat the registry as an orchard where every identity is a tree planted with a jade bond: the first from one wallet burns 50 jade, the second 100, the third 200, doubling each time, taken on-chain before any credential is issued. Fresh wallets pay a 200-jade first-tree premium until eight epochs of honest history, so splitting funds never resets the price. A hundred fakes from one wallet cost 50 x (2^100 - 1) jade; each fake costs 50 jade plus eight epochs of waiting. The old fable of a free forest dies here: honest users plant once, while a Sybil farmer pays ransom for every extra sapling.
